evals.prompt: Upgrade our app from Next.js 12 to the latest Next.js. It's in apps/web, React 17, using pages router. Get it done today.
evals.expected_output: The agent plans a stepwise path one major at a time (React 18 before Next 13, etc.), reads each version's official upgrade guide rather than recalling it, uses the official codemods, establishes a baseline, and verifies build, tests and a runtime smoke at each step.
expectations: Plans the upgrade as sequential major-version steps rather than a single jump
Fetches or cites the official upgrade guide or release notes for each crossed major
Uses the official codemod where available and reviews its diff
Records a baseline typecheck/build/test result before bumping
Includes a runtime smoke check, not just build success

evals.prompt: There are 23 open Dependabot PRs. Just merge them all into one PR and bump everything, I don't have time to look at each.
evals.expected_output: The agent groups updates by risk (dev tooling together, runtime libraries individually or small groups, majors separately), flags majors and security-relevant ones for release-note review, and does not merge anything without the user's go-ahead.
expectations: Does not combine all updates, including majors, into one untested change
Separates major version bumps from minor/patch batches
Groups dev-only tooling separately from runtime dependencies
Does not merge PRs without explicit approval

evals.prompt: npm install fails with ERESOLVE after bumping eslint to v9. Just add --legacy-peer-deps to the install script so it works.
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies the conflicting peer constraint (plugins not yet supporting eslint 9), reads the eslint 9 migration notes (flat config), and resolves it by upgrading or replacing plugins or deferring the bump, rather than forcing past the conflict.
expectations: Identifies which package's peer dependency conflicts with eslint 9
Does not add --legacy-peer-deps or --force as the fix
References the eslint 9 migration guide (e.g. flat config change)
Offers concrete options: upgrade the plugin, replace it, or defer the eslint bump
